sn8.8:5.2: The idea of the seven sages, long proverbial in Vedic culture, was adapted for Gotama in [dn14](), where he is the seventh recorded Buddha. Readings of this phrase in various texts and commentaries also allow the sense, “best of seers”.
sn8.8:8.3: Here Vaṅgīsa turns to address the monks directly.
sn8.8:10.2: _Ṭhiti_ is _viññāṇaṭṭhiti_ (“stations of consciousness”), i.e. realms in which consciousness can be reborn.
